build_paddleocrvl_image_processor: build a PaddleOCRVLImageProcessorPil instance with custom min_pixels and max_pixels for image preprocessing
run_smart_resize: run smart_resize to compute optimal image dimensions respecting min_pixels, max_pixels, and grid factor constraints
test_paddleocrvl_preprocess: test the preprocess method to convert images into pixel_values and image_grid_thw tensors
get_paddleocrvl_patch_count: get the number of image patches for a given image height and width using smart_resize and grid division
review_paddleocrvl_standardize_kwargs: review _standardize_kwargs to validate size dict with shortest_edge and longest_edge requirements
